entries.summary: Arena-Hard-Auto documents automated evaluation of instruction-tuned language models using model-based judges. The former lmarena repository now resolves to Arena-OSS/arena-hard-auto.
entries.selection_context: Trace the repository move and compare a specific benchmark version, prompt set and judge configuration.
entries.limitations: Check judge bias, style control, provider costs and evaluation settings. Published benchmark scores and correlation claims were not independently reproduced.
entries.decision: Retain the published route as a dated unranked reference when absent from current discovery.

entries.summary: This repository curates papers and resources on language models in social science, with a stated focus on psychology and intrinsic values. It is a reading collection rather than an executable evaluation service.
entries.selection_context: Find surveys, datasets and research on evaluation, alignment and social simulation, then consult the individual papers.
entries.limitations: The collection reflects its maintainers' selection and taxonomy. Inclusion is not validation of a paper, dataset or method; no research results were independently reproduced.
entries.decision: Retain the published route as a dated unranked reference when absent from current discovery.
